app_description.message: Inspect, copy, and replay Fetch / XHR requests from the current tab in Chrome's side panel.

waiting_for_requests_hint.message: Refresh or interact with the current page. Fetch / XHR requests will appear here.

select_request.message: Select a request to view details

select_request_hint.message: Select a request from the list above.

current_page_hint.message: The request is sent in the context of the current tab

max_requests_hint.message: Oldest records are removed when the limit is reached

max_response_body_hint.message: Larger response bodies are not kept in memory

auto_capture_hint.message: Start as soon as the side panel opens

settings_privacy_note.message: ApiViewer connects to the current tab only while the side panel is open and disconnects when it closes.

consent_title.message: Allow ApiViewer to read network requests from the current tab

consent_description.message: Captured content may include sign-in tokens, cookies, or other sensitive information. Please review how the data is handled.

what_is_read_detail.message: URLs, request and response headers, request bodies, and response bodies for Fetch / XHR requests in the current tab.

how_it_is_stored_detail.message: Captured records stay in browser memory, are never uploaded to the developer's servers, and are cleared when the side panel closes.

replay_requests_detail.message: Edited content is sent to the destination you enter only after you click Send, optionally using the current page's sign-in session.

consent_declined.message: Permission has not been granted. ApiViewer will not connect the debugger or read network requests. You can close the side panel or grant permission here later.

consent_policy_prefix.message: By agreeing, you confirm that you have read the data handling summary.

copied_request_body.message: Copied request body to the clipboard

copied_response_body.message: Copied response body to the clipboard

invalid_http_url.message: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.

background_reconnecting.message: The background connection was interrupted. Reconnecting…

background_retry.message: The background connection was interrupted. Reconnect and try again.

consent_save_error.message: Could not save permission. Try again.

switch_page_and_retry.message: Switch to a regular web page and reconnect.

change_search_hint.message: Try another search term or request type.

resume_capture_hint.message: Use the status button above to resume capturing Fetch / XHR requests.

request_body_unavailable.message: The request body is unavailable. The request may have started before capture began.

request_has_no_body.message: This request has no request body.

binary_response_hint.message: This response contains binary data. You can copy the Base64 data, but it is not rendered in the panel.

response_too_large.message: The response body exceeds the configured size limit and was not kept in memory.

response_unavailable.message: Chrome did not provide this response body. This can happen with caching, cross-process navigation, or streaming responses.

details_still_loading.message: Request details are still loading. Try again shortly.

confirm_cancel_sending.message: The request is still being sent. Cancel it and go back?

confirm_discard_changes.message: Unsaved changes will be lost. Go back?

headers_helper.message: Browser-managed headers are read-only. Sensitive values are hidden by default.

params_helper.message: Turn off a row to temporarily remove that parameter from the URL.

no_query_parameters.message: This URL has no query parameters.

method_no_body.message: {method} requests do not send a request body. Change the request method to continue editing.

no_form_fields.message: The request body has no form fields.

form_field_send_label.message: Include form field {index} in the request

replay_response_hint.message: Send the request to view its response here.

page_request_failed.message: The page could not complete this request.

redirected_to.message: The request was redirected. Final URL: {url}

replay_response_too_large.message: The response body exceeds the configured size limit and was not saved with the replay result.

binary_response_no_preview.message: The response contains binary data and cannot be previewed in this version.

confirm_delete.message: A DELETE request may delete data. Send it to {target}?

confirm_modify.message: A {method} request may modify site data. Send it to {target}?

invalid_json_format.message: The request body is not valid JSON and cannot be formatted.

fix_url_before_params.message: Fix the URL before editing query parameters.

copy_permission_error.message: Copy failed. Allow clipboard access in Chrome settings.

protected_page.message: Chrome protects this page, so requests cannot be captured. Switch to a regular web page and try again.

page_not_connected.message: The current page is not connected, so the request cannot be sent.

unreadable_response.message: The page did not return a readable response.

http_only.message: Only HTTP and HTTPS requests can be replayed.

request_body_too_large.message: The request body exceeds the configured size limit.

request_canceled_or_timed_out.message: The request was canceled or timed out while waiting for a response.

page_execution_error.message: An error occurred while the page was sending the request.

cannot_connect_current_tab.message: Cannot connect to the current tab

debugger_in_use.message: The current tab is already being inspected by DevTools or another debugger. Close it and try again.

inspection_not_allowed.message: Chrome does not allow this page to be inspected. Switch to a regular web page and try again.

debugger_canceled.message: The debugger connection was canceled by the user.

devtools_replaced.message: Chrome DevTools took over the debugger connection.

debugger_detached.message: The debugger connection was closed. Click to retry.
